status: draft for review (Yarrow 0.2); changes bump the version
description: The Hexis-S1 question set: a router answers every question in one forward pass, returns typed values with calibrated probabilities, and generates no text. Trigram options are Fuxi indices 0-7 (bottom line most significant); hexagram options are King Wen numbers 1-64. Hexagram arithmetic lives in yarrow.hexmath, never in the model.

Noul.meaning: a calibrated probability that the proposition holds

form.distribution: option -> probability, every option present, sum 1

Choice.meaning: a full distribution, the reported option and a confidence scalar

questions.rule: distribution equals the product of the line_1..line_3 Bernoulli probabilities (the line heads parameterise the trigram head)
distribution equals the product of the line_4..line_6 Bernoulli probabilities
always the 8 x 8 product of the trigram heads; the reported hexagram is the King Wen number of the reported trigrams; never a flat 64-way head until data justify it
